pmc-12490326.title: Necrotizing E. coli pneumonia with subsequent pneumothorax in a dog: a case report
pmc-12490326.creator: Victoria Vida Vazin, Sara Huebner, Teagan Deforge, Michael Wood, Athanasia Mitropoulou
pmc-12490326.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Necrotizing pneumonia is a poorly described and rarely reported phenomenon in veterinary medicine. The objective of this case report is to describe the successful management of a case of necrotizing pneumonia in a dog requiring medical and surgical management. This case describes a 9-year-old male neutered Siberian Husky mix that presented to an emergency center for a chronic cough not responsive to antibiotics including doxycycline and amoxicillin—clavulanate. Diagnostic imaging studies were consistent with severe multilobular pneumonia, pleural effusion and secondary pneumothorax.
